Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță și servicii de afaceri și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
20 years on the Romanian IT market and still growing.
 Part of the HN Services Group, with offices in France, Spain, Portugal, and Luxembourg, HN Services Romania is about building real careers, not just filling roles.
 What you’ll find here:
 • Digital transformation projects with real impact
 • A wide range of technical roles across modern and legacy technologies (yes, COBOL is still very much alive)
 • Exposure to diverse industries and international envi ronments
 • Continuous growth through our in-house software development training center (HN Training Institute)
 💡We are currently looking for experienced professionals to deliver high-quality, stable, and resilient software solutions.
 Key Responsibilities: 
Create a framework for automation testing using Digital.ai or Browserstack, depending on the project needs and group recommendations.
Propose a mobile test automation strategy/plan, facilitating automated scripts, maintenance and design (framework, modularization etc.)
Contribute to the definition of acceptance criteria for user stories and write associated acceptance scenarios
Design, write, and execute validation test plans for each iteration
Design test scenarios and cases ensuring there is traceability back to all business requirements
Design and implement test repository: test cases with associated test data made available to the team
Implement regression testing
Help define and regularly update team deliverables (Definition of Ready, Definition of Done etc.)
Monitor the resolution of defects and produce test evidence
Provide the necessary elements for test documentation and test reports
Collaborate and interact with the other testers from other squads within the Tribe
Collaborate with the Center of Expertise colleagues
 What we are looking for: 
Advanced English level, written and spoken
Previous experience in automation with Appium, Java/Javascript, Selenium
Previous experience in writing BDD scenarios for cross-functional clarity with Cucumber
Previous experience in API testing, collections and scripts with Postman or similar tools
Previous experience with JIRA (tracking anomalies/backlog/user stories within the squad)
Knowledge of agile methodology
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to communicate efficiently with the team (business, developers, POs)
The ability to work and collaborate with others
Good planning, organization, and time management skills
 Nice to have: 
ISTQB certification would be a plus
Previous experience in Mobile Testing
Previous experience in banking projects
 Only eligible candidates will be contacted for further information and start of the recruitment process.
